type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M),
  ResiduesFinite M →
    ∀ (φ : ↥M.K),
      IsBelyi M hDVR φ →
        ∀ (hfin : (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite) (P : Place ↥M.K),
          (if φ ∈ ↑P then ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1 else -ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1) + (cuspDivisor M hDVR φ hfin) P =
            poleMultiplicity M hDVR φ P + ord M hDVR P (φ * (φ - 1))
